Name: Custom NPC Ivaras - Heart Event Expansion
Author: Charnoodle101
Description:
Do you love [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/44610]Ivaras[/url] and wish that you could have a few more heart events for him ... as a treat? Then, this mod might be the mod for you!

Custom NPC Ivaras - Heart Event Expansion adds 5 additional heart events for our favourite Wizard's apprentice - and adds a heart event at 1, 3, 5, 7 and 9 hearts (with slight adjustments to the 14 heart event too)!

Just as with the main mod - this mod is SVE compatible. Just add the corresponding SVE file (or Vanilla file if playing without SVE installed) - and off you go!

[b]NB! [/b]Due to the way that the events have been coded, you might experience duplicates of the Ivaras main mod's events if you add this mod mid-save, and you have already experienced Ivaras' heart events. For this reason, it would probably be best to add to a new save, or at least add this mod along with the main Ivaras mod (add both at the same time), so you can experience his story from the beginning with no duplicate events!

Heart Events - 
[spoiler][b]1 Heart Event[/b]
Requirements: Cindersap Forest between 8 PM and 11 PM, on a sunny day

[b]3 Heart Event[/b]
Requirements: Cindersap Forest, on Fri or Sun, between 11 AM and 3PM, on a sunny day. Will only activate four or more days after the 2 heart event

[b]5 Heart Event[/b]
Requirements: Secret Woods, between 6 AM and 5 PM, after having received a letter from Ivaras, on a sunny day. Will only activate four or more days after the 4 heart event

[b]7 Heart Event[/b]
Requirements: Pelican Beach, between 8 PM and 11 PM, on a sunny day. Will only activate four or more days after the 6 heart event

[b]9 Heart Event[/b]
Requirements: Mountains, between 9 PM and 12 AM, on a sunny day. Will only activate four or more days after the 8 heart event[/spoiler]
This is my very first mod attempt, so despite a lot of testing, there may be some errors! If you have any issues, please log a bug report on the mod page and include a [b]SMAPI log[/b] (https://smapi.io/log) and I will try my best to assist!

[b]Thank you![/b]

[list]
[*]A huge thank you to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/starfyzz]starfyzz[/url] - for publishing the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/44610]Custom NPC Ivaras[/url] mod and encouraging me to publish this mod <3[/*]
[*]A big thank you to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/MaggPlays]MaggPlays[/url] - for helping me to figure out why my code wasn't working, and being so kind to a newbie <3[/*]
[*]... and thank you to you, for downloading this mod. I hope you enjoy the additional events, and I hope that you enjoy having a little more Ivaras to experience <3[/*]
[/list]
